messages:
samira: Scheduling user_email_normalize migration for maintenance window 02:00 UTC. Noticed analytics backfill alg-21 also targeting users table then. potential lease clash.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Preflight: requesting migration lease user_email_normalize v1 lease_id=mx-b2 TTL=900s.
analytics_bot: alg-21: holding long-lived read lease lease_id=alg-21 TTL=3600s, progress 48%.
ori_sre: Past collisions caused PK-swap stalls. Options: delay migration 15m, preempt backfill for short checkpoint, or use tiebreaker favoring migrations.
db_lee: Migration requires exclusive advisory lock for PK swap; if backfill keeps lease we block ~45m. prefer automated preempt with resume token.
samira: Can analytics accept a 10m pause? We can pin readers to v3.readpin during the change.
analytics_bot: alg-team: we can checkpoint and yield for up to 12m if we get resume token and ETA. consent logged: https://ci/alg/21/consent
deploy-bot: Deploybot: command available `/deploybot lease-preempt --target migration --grace=600 --reason "email-normalize"`. Dry run recommended.
ori_sre: also add safety: auto-abort if db.lock_waits > 10s for 3m. db oncall will be paged.
samira: running dry_run of preempt now. `/deploybot lease-preempt --dry_run`
deploy-bot: Deploybot: dry_run handshake: suggested action stagger 10m; analytics progress 48% -> acceptable.
db_lee: scheduling migration at 02:10 UTC and applying reader pin v3.readpin TTL=1800s. rollback playbook posted to runbook.
analytics_bot: alg-21: checkpointed at 48%, resume_token=resume://alg/21/tk-4.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: starting migration run_id=1745559990-1 logs: https://deploylog/migrations/1745559990
db_lee: acquired advisory lock `pg_advisory_lock(555123)`, starting background normalize.
nori_sre: watching lock metrics. small latency bump to 200ms, within expectations.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: migration progress 40%.
db_lee: preparing PK swap, will attempt atomic swap to minimize lock time.
nori_sre: alert triggered briefly for db.lock_waits 9.8s, below abort threshold. continuing.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: PK swap applied, migration complete. releasing lease mx-b2. audit: https://deploylog/migrations/1745559990/success
samira: removing read pin and updating release notes: "user_email_normalize completed with brief analytics preempt; resume token used."
analytics_bot: alg-21: resuming from token tk-4, ETA 14m.
nori_sre: follow-up task: add auto-stagger rule when long-lived analytics leases overlap migration windows.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: closing thread for migration 1745559990.
